learning_outcomes.text: Determines the forces and moments acting on machine elements. Calculates stresses and deformations for static and dynamic conditions.
Defines shafts and axles, calculates them according to design parameters / performs strength control.
Defines / classifies threaded elements, performs design and calculations, and can select from standards.
Defines shaft-hub connections (key connections and interference fits), calculates / performs strength control.
Knows the factors affecting welding, calculates / performs strength control for welded connections.

syllabus_topics: Definition and classification of machine elements according to their functions
Forces, moments, and stresses acting on machine elements
Strength calculation: Static and variable loading
Shafts and axles: Cylindrical shafts, profile shafts, cam shafts, crankshafts
Shaft-hub connections: Shrink fit, conical fit connections
Threaded connections: Definition, classification, areas of use, standards
Threaded connections: Force-moment transmission, strength calculation
Threaded connections: Strength calculation under dynamic loading
assessment_rules: The overall grade is composed of 40% in-term performance and 60% final exam. In-term performance consists of 20% homework, 70% midterm exam, and 10% quiz.
